about: How OMP resends a tool call whose arguments never parsed as JSON: an object holding only the parser's message and a preview of the raw text. The preview is the raw text whole when it has at most keep_utf16_units UTF-16 code units, else its first keep_utf16_units units followed by marker, where {omitted} is the number of units left out. Reconciliation accepts it only for the same archived call whose arguments are not JSON (palimnesis.harness_strings, archive.transcript).

previews.evidence: eval/fixtures/omp-18.16.0/length_stopped_call.json (R58); OMP 18.16.0 bundle, functions qwt and wae (String.prototype.slice and length); D104
